title: Coordenadora Segurança Trabalho - Afirmativa Para Mulheres
description:
Coordenador(a) de Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional (SSO)

Profissional será responsável por liderar a área de Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional da unidade industrial, atuando como ponto focal técnico e estratégico, garantindo a integridade física das pessoas, a conformidade legal e a evolução contínua da cultura de segurança.

Principais Responsabilidades

Atuar como ponto focal técnico da unidade industrial, apoiando gerência e colaboradores na tomada de decisão.

Mapear e gerenciar riscos críticos (AGR), aplicando matriz de criticidade e modelo de controle de barreiras.

Elaborar, implementar e acompanhar o Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR), analisando riscos qualitativos e quantitativos por meio de relatórios técnicos especializados.

Garantir cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR10, NR12, NR13, NR20, NR33 e NR35) e avaliar tecnicamente laudos e liberações de atividades críticas.

Conduzir investigações de acidentes de forma estruturada (análise de causa raiz, plano de ação e verificação de eficácia).

Desenvolver e revisar procedimentos de segurança, promovendo melhoria contínua.

Coordenar programas de treinamento e capacitação em segurança do trabalho, fortalecendo comportamento preventivo.

Gerenciar terceiros (integração, capacitação, avaliação técnica e liberação de atividades críticas), incluindo gestão de grandes contratos industriais.

Apoiar atividades relacionadas a perícias trabalhistas e previdenciárias.

Utilizar ferramentas de análise e indicadores (Power BI, SAP e Excel) para gestão de performance e tomada de decisão.

Atuar com foco em Melhoria Contínua e TPM (Total Productive Maintenance).

Requisitos Indispensáveis

Experiência de 8 a 10 anos na área de Segurança em indústria

Mínimo de 3 a 4 anos de experiência em Coordenação de Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional

Vivência sólida com treinamentos e gestão de equipe

Experiência estruturada em investigação de acidentes

Conhecimento em matriz de criticidade e modelo de controle de barreiras

Excel intermediário

CREA ativo

Formação

Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Ambiental

Especialização concluída em Segurança do Trabalho (obrigatório)

title: Analista De Implantação Erp – Módulos Fiscal/Contábil Ou Supply Chain
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.

Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.

Responsabilidades:

  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testesdas funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.

Requisitos:

  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens;

Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:

  • Conhecimento Supply Chain: Rotina de Compras, Pricing (Precificação de Produtos e Margem Líquida), Recebimento de Mercadorias, Conhecimento Básico da Tributação (NCM, IPI, ICMS, PIS), Processos no Varejo.

  • Conhecimento ouvivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;

  • Visão analíticapara apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: Travel Designer

The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of luxury hospitality, understands the expectations of affluent travelers, and can manage multiple requests while transforming travel inspiration into flawlessly executed journeys.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams and trusted global partners to ensure every trip reflects the highest standards of luxury and service.

You are passionate about travel, detail-oriented, and skilled at building strong relationships with discerning clients. You intuitively understand their preferences and expectations, delivering highly personalized journeys with professionalism and care. Every interaction you lead reflects a refined standard of luxury service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bespoke, end-to-end itineraries tailored to each client's travel style and preferences
  • Create and maintain long-term client relationships through prompt, thoughtful communication and flawless planning experience
  • Provide expert destination guidance with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards
  • Oversee all aspects of trip planning, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and seamless execution

Qualifications

title: Starrocks Database Engineer (Dbe) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage;
    no PoCs)
  • Provenexperience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL.
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus: Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus: Contributions to open-source database projects.

What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location & working style

  • Remote‐first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‐on‐the‐ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‐term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‐functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company's global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business

Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil

objectives

  • Support the efficient and cost‐effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.

To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

equivalent experience.

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively

Key Responsibilities May Include:

A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.Js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

O que nós estamos procurando;
  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).

O que oferecemos;

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso "Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;

  • Artefact é olugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.

You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.

Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team's single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Global Sales Executive | Fluent in English

At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect Brazilian talent with global companies that value performance, commercial intelligence, and consistency. With over 10 years of experience in outsourcing and staff augmentation, we support structured commercial operations focused on measurable results.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals who are fluent in English and want to build a strong career in international B2B sales, working directly with the North American market in a high-performance environment.

What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation of R$5,000 + performance bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, Monday to Friday (12 PM – 21 PM BRT)
  • Direct exposure to U.S. executives and decision-makers
  • Paid intensive training (3–5 weeks) with internal certifications
  • Real long-term career growth opportunities (SDR → AE → Leadership)
  • Structured, metrics-driven, high-performance environment

What You Will Do

  • Conduct outbound prospecting in the North American market (calls, emails, LinkedIn)
  • Identify and qualify B2B decision-makers
  • Generate and schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives
  • Follow structured outreach cadences and messaging frameworks
  • Maintain CRM hygiene and pipeline organization
  • Track activity metrics (calls, emails, meetings booked, conversion rates)
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to improve qualification quality

What We Are Looking For

  • 1+ year of experience in Outbound Sales, SDR, or Business Development
  • Fluent English (C1+)
  • Strong communication and persuasion skills
  • High resilience and comfort with cold outreach
  • Data-driven and performance-oriented mindset
  • Familiarity with sales frameworks
  • Highly organized and disciplined profile

Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet home office

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Previous experience working with U.S. or international clients
  • Consistent performance hitting activity or meeting targets

Build Your International Career

Work directly with the U.S. market, develop strong outbound skills, and grow inside a structured, high-performance sales operation.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.
  • Editing videos and creating simple animations for social media use.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English

Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:

title: Gerente Comercial – Grandes Contas
description:
Gerente Comercial – Grandes Contas

Descrição

Sobre a HSM & SingularityU Brazil

HSM e SingularityU Brazil são referências em desenvolvimento de líderes e transformação de negócios, por meio de educação executiva, experiências imersivas e conteúdos de ponta em gestão, inovação e tecnologias exponenciais. Atuamos lado a lado com grandes organizações na construção de capacidades críticas para o presente e o futuro dos negócios.

Missão da posição

Liderar a estratégia e a operação comercial em grandes contas, com foco em crescimento de receita, relacionamento de longo prazo com C Level e desenho de soluções sob medida em educação executiva e transformação organizacional, alcançando a meta anual.

Principais responsabilidades

- Gerir um portfólio de grandes contas estratégicas, atuando como ponto focal entre os decisores do cliente (C Level, RH, Universidade Corporativa, Inovação, Negócio) e HSM/SingularityU.

- Construir, desenvolver e executar planos de conta anuais (account planning), com visão de longo prazo, pipeline estruturado e metas claras de crescimento e cross-sell.

- Prospecção e desenvolvimento de novas grandes contas alinhadas ao posicionamento de HSM e SingularityU Brazil.

- Mapear desafios de negócio, dores e prioridades estratégicas dos clientes, traduzindo em propostas de valor em educação executiva, programas customizados, missões, eventos in-company e soluções digitais.

- Conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas consultivas: diagnóstico, proposta, negociação, fechamento e pós venda, garantindo experiência excepcional do cliente.

- Trabalhar em forte parceria com as áreas internas (conteúdo, operações, marketing e produtos) para desenhar e entregar soluções sob medida.

- Gerenciar o funil de vendas com disciplina (CRM), garantindo acurácia de pipeline, previsibilidade de receita e atingimento da meta anual.

- Acompanhar indicadores-chave (receita, margem, ticket médio, churn, NPS, adoção dos programas) e propor ações de alavancagem.

- Representar HSM e SingularityU em reuniões estratégicas, apresentações executivas e eventos com clientes.

Meta e indicadores de sucesso

- Meta de receita anual, mediante a novos negócios (novas vendas e expansão em contas existentes).

- Percentual de atingimento de meta trimestral e anual.

- Crescimento de receita por conta e por cluster de soluções.

- Retenção e expansão de grandes contas (renovações e novos projetos).

- NPS / satisfação dos clientes e sponsors das contas.

Perfil desejado

Formação e experiência

- Necessário ter Ensino Superior completo em áreas relacionadas.

- Experiência em vendas consultivas B2B para grandes empresas (preferencialmente em educação executiva, consultoria, serviços ou soluções complexas).

- Histórico comprovado de entrega de metas anuais relevantes em carteira de grandes contas.

- Vivência em relacionamento com alta liderança (diretores, vice presidentes, CEOs, CHROs, CIOs etc.).

Competências técnicas

- Forte capacidade de diagnóstico de negócio e desenho de propostas de valor customizadas.

- Domínio de pipeline, forecast e uso de CRM.

- Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com conforto para apresentações executivas.

- Desejável inglês intermediário/avançado para interação com conteúdos e/ou interlocutores internacionais.

Competências comportamentais

- Visão estratégica e pensamento de longo prazo sobre desenvolvimento de contas.

- Perfil consultivo, escuta ativa e habilidade de formulação de insights para o cliente.

- Autonomia, senso de dono e disciplina de execução.

- Capacidade de transitar em ambientes complexos e influenciar múltiplos stakeholders.

- Interesse genuíno por temas de liderança, inovação, transformação digital e futuro do trabalho.

Local de trabalho

São Paulo (modelo a definir: híbrido, 3 dias presenciais, com presença em reuniões e eventos conforme necessidade).

Modalidade de contratação: PJ.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora | C - Asp Net
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

DESAFIO

  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web utilizando ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Implementar e otimizar soluções utilizando HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, e JSon, garantindo alta performance e usabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter banco de dados SQL Server, incluindo a criação e otimização de triggers, stored procedures e aplicação de regras de normalização.
  • Integrar e consumir WebServices (SOAP e REST) nas aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Controlar as mudanças no desenvolvimento de software para assegurar a estabilidade e evolução contínua dos projetos.
  • Identificar e corrigir problemas no código, bem como propor melhorias e oportunidades de refatoração para manter a qualidade do software.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócios e qualidade.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento, qualidade e maturidade de software.
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Linguagem de programação: domínio de aplicação e entendimento de sintaxe e desempenho de linguagens como ASP.NET c#, Java script, Json, Bootstrap
  • Experiência com WEB JS/Jquery/Ajax, Webforms, Bootstrap, HTML, JSon e CSS, SQL Server, incluindo normalização, triggers, e stored procedures.
  • Conhecimento em SOAP e REST.
  • Habilidade analítica para detectar problemas e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes equipes.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER

  • Experiência prévia no mercado de corretoras de seguros.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ

️ Auxílio Alimentação: para você escolher suas refeições com liberdade.

Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos.

Assistência Médica SulAmérica: Cuidado completo para você e sua família.

️ Seguro de Vida e Funeral: Proteção garantida.

Auxílio Home Office: Apoio financeiro para montar e manter seu espaço de trabalho em casa, com conforto e eficiência.

Plataforma Educacional: Acesso à plataformas para investir no seu desenvolvimento profissional.

Descontos em Farmácias: Economize com o Univers.

Crédito Consignado: Disponível após 6 meses de empresa para seus projetos pessoais.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.

O DESAFIO:

  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da "cadeia de pensamento" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP), garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service, priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker, Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI).

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Ux & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer

About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.

You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.

This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.

What You'll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing

This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

Area: Corporate & Investment Banking / Global Markets/FX

We are looking for a Business Analyst with experience in FX Markets to join our team and contribute to the design and delivery of key initiatives across pricing, trading, eFX, and post-trade workflows. What We Offer

  • The opportunity to contribute to key transformation initiatives within Global Markets business.

  • Professional growth and learning opportunities through CIB programs and digital skills development.
  • The chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative market solutions.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.

Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!

About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.

We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?

Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.
Skills & Qualifications:
  • Technical Expertise:
  • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
  • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
  • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
  • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
  • Problem-solving Ability:
  • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
  • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Communication Skills:
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
  • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
  • Organizational Skills:
  • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Experience:
  • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
  • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:
  • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
  • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
  • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.

Who You Are:

  • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
  • You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
  • Passion for helping others internally and externally
  • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
  • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.

title: Consultor De Processos – Secagem
description:
A Arauco é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e se compromete com a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas práticas de contratação.

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Oferecer suporte técnico especializado na operação e otimização dos processos de secagem de polpa celulósica, através do mapeamento, monitoramento dos processos e gestão dos recursos, consumos de insumos e materiais de operação, sistemas e equipamentos, assegurando a produtividade das máquinas de secagem, dentro do padrão de qualidade e eficiência, otimizando custos e minimizando desperdício, através de intervenções nos parâmetros e processos, implementação de novas tecnologias ou métodos de produção, visando a melhoria contínua no desempenho dos equipamentos e melhor qualidade da Celulose, bem como, realizar a gestão técnica dos operadores da sua área de atuação.

Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver, validar e implementar planos de otimização do processo de secagem de polpa celulósica, garantindo eficiência operacional, qualidade do produto e melhor utilização de recursos.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos sistemas de secagem, com foco em eficiência energética, redução de custos, sustentabilidade e minimização de perdas.
  • Monitorar as operações diárias, assegurando conformidade com padrões de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente.
  • Pesquisar, analisar e aplicar novas tecnologias e práticas para aprimorar desempenho, confiabilidade e impacto ambiental do processo.
  • Garantir que o produto final atenda aos requisitos de qualidade, realizando análises, testes e ajustes necessários.
  • Capacitar e orientar equipes operacionais, disseminando melhores práticas e apoiando o desenvolvimento técnico, inclusive em fases de startup.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Engenharia, Manutenção, Qualidade, Logística e Comercial em projetos de melhoria, inovação e aumento da disponibilidade dos ativos.
  • Participar do planejamento e execução de Paradas Gerais, contribuindo para mitigação de riscos e otimização de custos.
  • Implantar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (custos, produtividade, disponibilidade), promovendo ajustes e evolução contínua dos processos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Saúde Ocupacional e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Celulose e Papel, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing ou áreas afins;
  • Sólida experiência em indústria de celulose;
  • Vivência em comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento consolidado em sistemas de gestão da qualidade (normas ISO);
  • Experiência commetodologias de análise e solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento emdesign experimental (DOE) e estatística avançada;
  • Conhecimento emgestão com foco no cliente;
  • Domínio técnicodos processos de Secagem;
  • Amplo conhecimento do processo produtivo de celulose e papel;
  • Experiência comSistema PIMS e Balanço de Produção;
  • Vivência em Gestão da Rotina Diária (GRD);
  • Inglês e Espanhol serão considerados diferenciais;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar em Inocência/MS.

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We're privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word 'partner' over 'vendor', and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.

A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

description:

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência

Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)

Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers

Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)

title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level

About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.

This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.

What You'll Do

- Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

- Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

- Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

- Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

- Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

- Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

- Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

- 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

- Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

- Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

- Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined

Nice to Have

- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up

How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.

We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.

What You'll Get

- Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Operação de Mina Sênior com experiência em perfuração e desmonte, responsável por planejar, acompanhar e otimizar os desmontes de rocha, garantindo segurança, produtividade e eficiência operacional.

Atuará no dimensionamento de planos de fogo, acompanhamento das operações de perfuração em campo e análise de resultados de desmonte, assegurando adequada fragmentação do material e aderência ao plano de lavra.

Procuramos um profissional analítico, com forte atuação em campo e foco em melhoria contínua, contribuindo para otimização dos processos e redução de custos operacionais.

  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas e novas tecnologias voltadas à otimização das operações de perfuração e desmonte.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia de Minas;
  • Experiência em operações de mina a céu aberto, com foco em perfuração e desmonte;
  • Experiência na elaboração e acompanhamento de planos de fogo e controle de parâmetros de perfuração;
  • Conhecimento emdimensionamento de explosivos e acompanhamento operacional;

description:

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Fleet & Cost Analyst
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our team includes former leaders from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others, united by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while reducing transportation costs for one of the region’s most economically vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo.


About the Role

As a Fleet Reliability & Cost Analyst, you will support programs that improve the reliability and cost efficiency of Vammo’s fleet across vehicles, batteries, and swap stations.This role sits at the intersection of engineering, operations, and data analysis. You will work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, and Customer Support to monitor fleet performance, track field tests, and support fleet-wide improvement programs. We are looking for someone with a strong engineering mindset who is also comfortable working with operational data, cross-functional teams, and real-world execution challenges.


What You Will Do

  • Maintain and analyze spare parts cost dashboards across vehicles, batteries, and swap stations.
  • Identify abnormal signals in fleet data such as early failures, unusual consumption patterns, or operational inconsistencies.
  • Support engineering investigations by preparing data and analysis on component performance and failure patterns.
  • Maintain tracking systems for fleet tests, including exposure metrics such as vehicles in test groups and kilometers accumulated.
  • Support coordination of fleet tests and ensure reliable tracking of results.
  • Track execution of fleet retrofit and improvement programs and maintain rollout visibility across the fleet.
  • Prepare operational reports that support engineering and business decision-making.


What We Are Looking For

  • 0–3 years of experience in engineering, operations, analytics, or consulting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working with data, operational metrics, and reporting tools
  • Ability to translate technical insights into operational actions
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Preferential Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or similar).
  • Advanced English proficiency.

title: Prodops Team Leader
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B and B2C businesses. Both divisions leverage Playtech’s proprietary technology to deliver innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging, and entertaining gaming experience. Playtech is the gaming industry's leading technology company delivering business intelligence-driven gaming software, services, content, and platform technology across the industry.
Read more about who we are and what we do here:

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Recognizing differences and ensuring our processes are transparent is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Job Description

Playtech is looking for a proactive Product Operation Team Leader with strong technical expertise and excellent communication skills.
As the Product Operation Team Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing and guiding the operational processes that support our production environments, ensuring seamless product delivery and stability. You will lead a team of engineers, driving operational excellence, implementing best practices, and fostering continuous improvement.

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Resolve most complex DevOps tasks.
  • Lead the team of Product Operations engineers.
  • Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing service‑management processes and develop a clear plan for their improvement.
  • Establish key operational performance indicators and create a clear plan to track, measure, and improve them.
  • Provide immediate respond for any alert.
  • Liaise with SL1/SL3, 3rd parties and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide regular reports to direct manager.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Have 5+ years’ experience as a DevOps engineer or SRE engineer, and 1+ years of leading/management experience.
  • Possess fluent verbal and writing communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrate strong understanding of the ITIL framework and bring hands-on experience working with production environments with zero tolerance for errors.
  • Bring strong experience in Linux, Docker, configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet), CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins), Cloud services (AWS), and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Nomad).
  • Have experience writing infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Have worked with monitoring systems (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios/Sensu) and logging solutions (Elastic Stack, Loki).
  • Interact effectively with senior management, technical subject matter experts, and business stakeholders.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Have experience supporting web applications with microservices architecture, including Akka cluster management and monitoring.
  • Bring knowledge of NoSQL database support (MongoDB, Couchbase) and NGINX server management.
  • Possess programming skills in Python/Bash.
  • Have worked in a global, multilingual organization.
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current working experience in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

Join our team at Playtech's new Brazilian office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.
